extras: Sync between iPad and desktop uses a local network web server; no external accounts or cloud services are used.
problem: Users need a way to create and embed freehand drawings, diagrams, and sketches directly into their Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Built on Quickdraw, the MIT-licensed infinite-canvas whiteboard SDK.
relations.plugin: Quickdraw, the MIT-licensed infinite-canvas whiteboard SDK

summary: Quickdraw allows users to create and embed freehand drawings and diagrams on an infinite canvas directly within Obsidian notes, supporting Apple Pencil input from iPad.
